_comment: Act bosses as data. The engine holds no project knowledge, so boss content lives here rather than in scripts/. Pools are chosen by act; acts past the Heart draw from 'endless'.

1.name: Unclear Requirements
1.intent: Will block ship until someone owns the decision.

1.name: The Undecided Architecture
1.intent: Will make every module wait on a choice nobody made.

1.name: Scope Without a Spec
1.intent: Will keep growing until Done is undefined.
1.acceptance: written Done + a vertical slice shipped

2.name: The Integration
2.intent: Will pass in isolation and fail together.

2.name: The Half-Migrated Schema
2.intent: Will strand you between two shapes of the same table.

2.name: Cross-Service Deadline
2.intent: Will make your timeline depend on a team you do not control.

3.name: The Scale Cliff
3.intent: Will hold until traffic doubles, then fail all at once.
3.acceptance: load test at 2x + a named bottleneck

3.name: The Compliance Gate
3.intent: Will not negotiate, and does not care about your sprint.

4.name: The Heart of the Codebase
4.intent: Will reveal that the thing everyone feared touching is load-bearing.
4.acceptance: the core path is covered, understood, and changed safely

endless.name: The Next Quarter
endless.intent: Will arrive whether or not you finished the last one.

endless.name: The Inherited Service
endless.intent: Will belong to you the moment its author leaves.
endless.acceptance: you can deploy it and explain it

endless.name: The Rewrite Proposal
endless.intent: Will promise that starting over is cheaper. It is not.
endless.acceptance: a written comparison and a decision either way

endless.name: The Slow Erosion
endless.intent: Will take one percent of your velocity every month, forever.
endless.acceptance: a measured trend that stops going down

endless.name: The On-Call Week
endless.acceptance: every page resolved and one made impossible
